WRITTEN EXAMPLE · FICTIONAL CALLER AND DETAILS
  1. AI client intake assistant

    Hello, I’m the AI client intake assistant. What would you like to speak to the team about?

  2. Caller

    I run a small design studio and want to talk about bookkeeping support.

  3. AI client intake assistant

    I can help arrange an introductory conversation. What is your name and business name?

  4. Caller

    Taylor Brooks, from Example Studio.

  5. AI client intake assistant

    When would a callback suit, and may the team use this number?

  6. Caller

    Tuesday afternoon would be ideal. This number is fine.

  7. AI client intake assistant

    I’ll pass your bookkeeping enquiry and callback preference to the team. They’ll contact you to arrange the conversation.
